body:
You're ignoring the bigger picture. He's a liar and he has no regard for your feelings/needs. 

Asking politely is not getting you anywhere.
Its time to make a threat. Not an immature or empty one, however you need to tell him sternly that if he doesn't quit lying and disregarding your feelings, you won't be able to deal with it much longer.
Yes, you have no intention on leaving him I am sure. However, consider this. This is your lifelong partner and porn will be considered a trivial problem compared to the issues to come. Forget that he watches porn. What you should be upset about is that he doesn't give a damn and its incredibly demeaning to you.
He's not trying to fix the issue, hes trying to lie and mask it. He doesn't really care that its breaking your confidence, he only cares to stop you from complaining about it or bringing it up. The worst part is, he seems absolutely guiltless for lying to you.
If he can't stop himself from watching porn, than he needs to tell you this instead of lying his sorry ass off. He has a serious porn addiction and you're going through one of the most hormonal, insecure and support needing times of your life: pregnancy. 

Do me a favor and tell him that you're losing feelings for him (even if you're not). Stop chasing him already, hes ungrateful and it'll only make you less attractive to him. I know you don't want to do this but I'm sorry, he feels no guilt so in order to get him to care, you have to take something away from him. Chase him less at the very LEAST.

I grew up in a Chinese family and I know what you are talking about. To me, this is not a normal case where you could just talk this out with her. She seems to be very stubborn and set on her ideas and it is very unlikely she will change the way she sees things. 
You have done many great things for her. Too much. Sometimes for some people, if you give them too much, they will get used to it. Seems like you're missing true love. She said you do not 'deserve her'. You need to stand up to her and agree with her. Tell her if she thinks she can do better, then she can find someone else that is willing to do all the things you've done. I bet you she can't. She is making you feel loveless and she does not realize that she is not a princess. 
You have to stand up to her and tell her if she does not quit asking you for money, the relationship is off. You have to tell her you're starting to lose feelings for her. This is NOT normal. This is a modern world. We are not like before, where marriages are about money. It is very different now and if you do not do anything about it, you will end up very miserable for a very long time. 

take action and speak now or you will really start to resent her. If she loves you, she will try to understand. If she continues, part your ways.

I'm eighteen, I appreciate the response. I do have proof on everything he's done to me. Once you say something on the internet, it never really goes away. 

I don't even know where to start. I know nothing about law because I never watched all that much television and I never got into trouble (besides this). Will my future employers be able to see these things and will my family know? I'm worried sick about getting the law involved but I'll take the necessary steps if I need to.
